course.title: Engineering Construction Management
course.department: Department of Building Engineering and Construction Management

content.value: A design-build-operate engineering company in Texas that owns a sizeable amount of land plans to lease the driliing rights (oii and gas only) to a mining and exploration company. The contract calls for the mining company to pay \$20,000 per year for 20 years beginning 3 years from now (i.e. beginning at the end of year 3 and continuing through year 22) plus. \$10,000 six years from now and \$15,000 sixteen years from now, Utilize engineering economy relations by hand to determine the four.equivalent values listed below at 16% per year. (1) Total present worth Pτ in year 0, (2) Future worth F in year 22, (3) Annual series over all 22 years and (4) Annual series over the first 10 years.
